notes:
Summary: Large health system (EHR, PHI) — strict air-gapped requirement driven by an upcoming federal grant audit. Primary ask: fully air-gapped appliance (no egress), HSM-backed keys, on-site install, and SOC/ISO paperwork. Redwood engaged for private deployment discussion in Sep 2025. POC planned but stalled when security elevated to infrastructure committee.

Key quotes/feedback:
- 'We cannot allow any outbound connections during data processing windows.' — Head of Infrastructure (10/12 call)
- 'If it can't be an appliance that sits in our data center, compliance won't sign off.' — CISO (1/22 call)

What happened:
- Initial interest strong: demo + security deep-dive, requested offline pricing for on-prem appliance.
- Security team issued extensive questionnaire; Redwood answered but could not commit to air-gapped physical appliance delivery within the required 8-week window.
- Procurement frozen due to grant timeline shift and budget reprioritization; legal required a signed attestation for air-gapped ops which Redwood does not currently provide as an out-of-the-box offering.
- Competitor (VaultAI-Private) proposed appliance-based solution with on-site install and handed-off operational SLA; Cerulean accepted VaultAI' demo, citing lower integration risk.

Internal notes / next actions:
